_what: What a built device is (fixturebody.rs, Q6315): the device kinds (as read: its own kind, lower case, spaces as underscores) that make it a light fixture or a plumbing fixture element, and the 3D body each kind of fixture is built as when nothing drawn or printed gives its size.
_basis: IFC 4 classes the model's fixtures apart from its devices: IfcLightFixture for luminaires, exit signs and emergency lights; IfcSanitaryTerminal for water closets, urinals, lavatories, sinks, tubs, showers, drinking fountains and floor drains. Sizes are the common catalog sizes of each kind (trade practice), used only where no document gives one, and marked inferred.
_size_in: A body's size, inches: [along the wall it is set against (its width), out from the wall (its depth), its height]. One set clear of every wall (a ceiling luminaire) has its width along plan x. Where it sits up and down stays its mounting height's (the documents', else the rules' default): a documented floor fixture's top is its documented height.

light_families.name: exit sign
light_families.basis: trade practice: an edge-lit or thermoplastic exit sign, about 12 in by 8 in, 2-3 in deep

light_families.name: emergency light
light_families.basis: trade practice: a two-head emergency battery unit, about 12 in wide, 4 in deep, 6 in high

light_families.name: troffer
light_families.basis: trade practice: a lay-in troffer is nominal 2 ft by 4 ft, about 5 in deep

light_families.name: downlight
light_families.basis: trade practice: a 6 in aperture recessed downlight, its trim about 7-8 in across, 6 in deep

light_families.name: strip
light_families.basis: trade practice: a strip or wrap luminaire, nominal 4 ft long, 4-6 in wide

light_families.name: vanity light
light_families.basis: trade practice: a vanity bar over a mirror, about 24 in long, 5 in from the wall

light_families.name: wall pack
light_families.basis: trade practice: an exterior wall pack, about 12 in wide, 8 in out from the wall

light_families.name: sconce
light_families.basis: trade practice: a wall sconce, about 6 in wide and out from the wall, 10 in high

light_families.name: pendant
light_families.basis: trade practice: a decorative pendant, about 16 in across

light_families.name: high bay
light_families.basis: trade practice: a round high-bay luminaire, about 16 in across

light_default.name: luminaire
light_default.basis: trade practice: no size printed and no word naming its shape: a nominal 1 ft square luminaire, 6 in deep

_light_wall_default: A luminaire set in a wall's face (a wall luminaire) of no known shape: a sconce's size.

light_wall_default.name: wall luminaire
light_wall_default.basis: trade practice: a wall luminaire of no printed size or shape: a sconce's, about 6 in wide and out from the wall, 10 in high

plumbing_families.name: water closet
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a floor-mounted tank water closet, about 20 in wide, 28 in out from the wall, 30 in to its tank top

plumbing_families.name: urinal
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a wall-hung urinal, about 18 in wide, 14 in out from the wall, 26 in high

plumbing_families.name: floor drain
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a floor drain's strainer, about 6 in square, at the floor

plumbing_families.name: tub
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a recessed bathtub, 60 in by 30 in, 20 in high

plumbing_families.name: shower
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a shower receptor, 36 in square, its curb about 4 in high

plumbing_families.name: service sink
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a floor mop basin, 24 in square, 12 in high

plumbing_families.name: lavatory
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a lavatory, about 20 in wide, 18 in out from the wall, its bowl about 8 in deep

plumbing_families.name: sink
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a counter sink, about 25 in by 22 in, 9 in deep

plumbing_families.name: drinking fountain
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a wall-mounted drinking fountain, about 18 in wide, 19 in out from the wall, 20 in high

plumbing_families.name: eyewash
plumbing_families.basis: trade practice: a wall-mounted eyewash bowl, about 16 in wide, 14 in out from the wall, 12 in high

_plumbing_default: A plumbing fixture of no known kind (a hose bibb, a washer box, a trap primer) keeps its rough-in box: no catalog size fits every one of them, so none is guessed (its body_basis says so).
_size_limits_in: A size its schedule prints (`2X4`, `60X32`) is taken only with each side in this range, inches: a value outside it is something else (a lamp count and wattage, a model number).
